import CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target : (MorphismProperty.monomorphisms (Type u)).IsStableUnderCobaseChange := by
  let C := Type u
  let P := MorphismProperty.monomorphisms C
  let I := MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.monomorphisms C
  let cobase_change := I.cobase_change
  exact cobase_change
